#  12253 - Status Seminar Heritage Studies: Progress Reports PhD Thesis Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **12253**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Status Seminar Heritage Studies: Progress Reports PhD Thesis**  |  
|  Status Seminar Heritage Studies: Aktueller Stand und Fortschritte des Dissertationsprojekts   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 6 - Architecture, Civil Engineering and Urban Planning   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. phil. habil. Blokker, Johanna 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 3 semesters  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | The seminar gives doctoral students in Heritage Studies the platform to discuss and further develop their own doctoral researches. To this end, students have to present and critically examine their own research against the background of foundational theoretical and methodological literature in Heritage Studies.  |  
| Contents:  | The students will learn to critically reflect on cultural and social scientific theories and methods in heritage studies. They will learn to apply these theories and methods in their own doctoral researches. The students will be asked to present their own research progress to the seminar group on a regular basis.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | No successful participation in associated phase-out module _11294 Tutorial - Research Colloquium_.  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Seminar / 6 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 90 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Will be announced at the beginning of the seminar.  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Essay, 15-20 pages (50%)
  * Presentation, 15min (50%)

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * Structural Doctoral Programme / Heritage Studies / PO 2017 

 |  
| Remarks:  |  
| Module Components:  | Status Seminar Heritage Studies: Progress Reports PhD Thesis (three semesters)  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  |
